topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Finding the hidden room was a mistake. The house, once so quiet, now feels different, heavier. I should have left the wall as it was, not pried into secrets meant to stay hidden. The room, dim and cold, with its whispering shadows, holds things I did not ask to know. Now, I can't escape the questions haunting me, the ones about why this space existed and why I had to uncover it. The walls, they seem to watch, to judge. Maybe I should have kept my curiosity locked away, safe.
